## do you know how it all started?

It began in Switzerland with inventor Karl Zysset. A simple idea turned a bicycle brake into the
world’s first garlic press, the susi, making it possible to enjoy garlic without smelly fingers.
This marked the beginning of zyliss, founded in 1951 and has been shaping kitchens ever since.
Explore our full story and celebrate 75 years of kitchen innovation with us.

It began in Switzerland with inventor Karl Zysset. A simple idea turned a bicycle brake into the
world’s first garlic press, the susi, making it possible to enjoy garlic without smelly fingers.
This marked the beginning of zyliss, founded in 1951 and has been shaping kitchens ever since.
Explore our full story and celebrate 75 years of kitchen innovation with us.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

Gas prices get a lot of attention, but they’re driven by a complex set of global factors, with crude
oil markets playing the central role. This explainer puts those dynamics into context and breaks
down what’s behind the numbers at the pump.

[Read More][38]
[Gas Prices Explained]

### **America Builds. America wins.**

Building new infrastructure allows energy to flow faster and more easily which could make energy
more affordable for consumers.

[Learn More][39]
[America Builds. America wins.]

# **ChefEquipment.com is joining Russell Hendrix!**

We want to take a moment to thank you for your continued support and loyalty. Your trust in
ChefEquipment.com has helped us grow, and we’re excited to bring you an even better experience
through Russell Hendrix, the leading name in foodservice equipment and supplies. We truly appreciate
your business and look forward to serving you at RussellHendrix.com.

## **Important Update**
* **On December 16**, pricing and the ability to add items to your cart will be turned off on
  ChefEquipment.com.
* The site will remain available for you to **retrieve past order details**.
* All new purchases will need to be made on [**RussellHendrix.com**][274] after Dec 15

### **Why Russell Hendrix?**

For over 80 years, Russell Hendrix has been supporting Canadian commercial kitchens from coast to
coast — from independent cafés and food trucks to full-scale restaurants and institutions. Behind
the scenes, ChefEquipment has already been part of the Russell Hendrix family.

What does this mean for you? You still get everything you love about ChefEquipment, plus more:****
* **Canada’s Largest Foodservice Equipment & Supplies Dealer** – trusted by professionals
  nationwide.
* **Three Major Distribution Centres Across Canada** – ensuring fast, efficient delivery from coast
  to coast.
* **Canada’s Largest Sales Force** – providing personalised support and expertise nationally.
* **Extensive Product Selection** – everything you need, plus thousands of new items and a
  constantly expanding range.

## MORE ABOUT US:

#### What types of food processing equipment does DC Norris North America supply?

DC Norris North America supplies industrial cooking equipment including process kettles, sous vide
cook tanks, bratt pans, woks, and Jet Cook™ systems; cooling equipment including belt chillers,
rotary tumble chillers, static coolers and vacuum cooling systems; process systems including cook
chill, cook quench chill, and clean in place; as well as can processing systems and equipment,
lifting and discharging equipment, drop rollers and slab formers, and transfer and holding vessels
for high-volume food manufacturers in the US and Canada.

#### What markets does DC Norris North America serve?

DC Norris North America serves manufacturers of ready meals, soups and sauces, beverages,
confectionery, desserts and preserves, dressings and dips, meat and poultry, rice, pasta and
vegetables, and fresh pet food across the United States and Canada.

#### Is DC Norris North America equipment NSF certified?

Select DC Norris North America equipment, including our commercial sous vide cook tank (Model CT-1)
and rotary tumble chillers, have NSF certification. All of the equipment in our portfolio meets or
exceeds the food safety standards required by US and Canadian food manufacturers.

#### Does DC Norris North America provide equipment installation and commissioning?

Yes. DC Norris North America provides full equipment integration, installation, and commissioning
services alongside process and equipment design, and ongoing spares support. At DC Norris North
America, we don’t just supply equipment, we engineer outcomes.

#### Where is DC Norris North America located?

DC Norris North America is headquartered in Traverse City, Michigan, and serves food manufacturers
throughout the United States and Canada.

## MORE ABOUT US:

#### What types of food processing equipment does DC Norris North America supply?

DC Norris North America supplies industrial cooking equipment including process kettles, sous vide
cook tanks, bratt pans, woks, and Jet Cook™ systems; cooling equipment including belt chillers,
rotary tumble chillers, static coolers and vacuum cooling systems; process systems including cook
chill, cook quench chill, and clean in place; as well as can processing systems and equipment,
lifting and discharging equipment, drop rollers and slab formers, and transfer and holding vessels
for high-volume food manufacturers in the US and Canada.

#### What markets does DC Norris North America serve?

DC Norris North America serves manufacturers of ready meals, soups and sauces, beverages,
confectionery, desserts and preserves, dressings and dips, meat and poultry, rice, pasta and
vegetables, and fresh pet food across the United States and Canada.

#### Is DC Norris North America equipment NSF certified?

Select DC Norris North America equipment, including our commercial sous vide cook tank (Model CT-1)
and rotary tumble chillers, have NSF certification. All of the equipment in our portfolio meets or
exceeds the food safety standards required by US and Canadian food manufacturers.

#### Does DC Norris North America provide equipment installation and commissioning?

Yes. DC Norris North America provides full equipment integration, installation, and commissioning
services alongside process and equipment design, and ongoing spares support. At DC Norris North
America, we don’t just supply equipment, we engineer outcomes.

#### Where is DC Norris North America located?

DC Norris North America is headquartered in Traverse City, Michigan, and serves food manufacturers
throughout the United States and Canada.

## New Releases and Playtests: The Biggest Announcements in PC and Console Gaming This Week

Hell Byte Studios’ debut title **Blood Reaver** is now available in Early Access on Steam, offering
a fast-paced, round-based, co-op FPS experience rooted in heavy metal and dark fantasy themes.
Players will face wave after wave of relentless demons, upgrading both weapons and abilities while
uncovering hidden lore in each map. Find out more or join the carnage via the game’s [Steam
page][13].

Slavic folklore comes alive in **Bylina** from Far Far Games and Digital Vortex Entertainment, now
launched on PC via Steam. Players control Kestrel, a would-be hero battling mythical foes and
exploring a semi-open world filled with secrets, nonlinear progression, and dark humor. PC players
who purchase Bylina within its first 30 days will receive the exclusive "Shroomie Power Armor";
console versions are set to arrive later in 2026—learn more on the [official Steam page][14].

**Tropico 7** has revealed its first gameplay teaser, promising fans new heights of island rule with
expanded archipelagos, campaign maps, and a robust political and city-building system. The latest
installment is set to arrive in 2026 for PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 5, complete with new terraforming
features and a reworked military system. For the full dev log and teaser, visit [Kalypso Media’s
blog][15].

**City States: Medieval** is now available in Early Access on Steam, letting players step into the
shoes of a 12th-century statesman managing a medieval city amid great kingdoms. Blending real-time
strategy, tactical combat, and trade mechanics, it features multiple starting cities and hero-led
campaigns shaped by player decisions. For more information, check out the [official Steam page][16].

The beloved medieval MMORPG **Gloria Victis** is back with a public playtest running until April 27,
marking the first major step towards its full relaunch after a long hiatus. Players can experience
large-scale PvP battles, robust crafting, and non-target combat, with in-game rewards promised for
playtest participants. Join the event or wishlist the game over on [Steam][17].

Peter Molyneux makes a grand return with **Masters of Albion**, launching in Early Access on Steam
April 22 for $24.99 USD. Combining god game mechanics, city-building, and real-time combat, Masters
of Albion delivers both nostalgic and innovative gameplay, alternating between open-ended
construction by day and intense defense phases by night. To see the latest footage and wishlist the
title, visit the [Steam page][18].

**Hello Neighbor 3** has entered pre-alpha on Steam, welcoming new and returning players to the
eerily charming town of Raven Brooks. The pre-alpha showcases expanded locations, a revamped
protagonist, improved stealth mechanics, and a unique objective system—making it the most accessible
entry point for franchise newcomers. Learn more about the game at its [official Steam page][19].

disabling cookies without completely disabling the functionality and features they add to this site.
It is recommended that you leave on all cookies if you are not sure whether you need them or not in
case they are used to provide a service that you use. Disabling Cookies You can prevent the setting
of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser (see your browser Help for how to do this). Be
aware that disabling cookies will affect the functionality of this and many other websites that you
visit. Disabling cookies will usually result in also disabling certain functionality and features of
the this site. Therefore it is recommended that you do not disable cookies. The Cookies We Set
Account related cookies If you create an account with us then we will use cookies for the management
of the signup process and general administration. These cookies will usually be deleted when you log
out however in some cases they may remain afterwards to remember your site preferences when logged
out. Login related cookies We use cookies when you are logged in so that we can remember this fact.
This prevents you from having to log in every single time you visit a new page. These cookies are
typically removed or cleared when you log out to ensure that you can only access restricted features
and areas when logged in. Form related cookies When you submit data to through a form such as those
found on contact pages or comment forms cookies may be set to remember your user details for future
correspondence. Site preference cookies In order to provide you with a great experience on this site
we provide the functionality to set your preferences for how this site runs when you use it. In
order to remember your preferences we need to set cookies so that this information can be called
whenever you interact with a page is affected by your preferences.
Third Party Cookies In some special cases we also use cookies provided by trusted third parties. The
following section details which third party cookies you might encounter through this site.
This site uses Google Analytics which is one of the most widespread and trusted analytics solution
on the web for helping us to understand how you use the site and ways that we can improve your
experience. These cookies may track things such as how long you spend on the site and the pages that

cookies, see the official Google Analytics page. We also use social media buttons and/or plugins on
this site that allow you to connect with social network in various ways. For these to work, the
social networks may set cookies through our site which may be used to enhance your profile on their
site, or contribute to other purposes outlined in their respective privacy policies.

## Find Your Next Conveyance Solution

##### Learn about our product lines and how we can tackle your production challenges.

#### Timing Screws

Timing Screws and Feed Screws are used to move and guide products through packaging equipment
machines. They feed the equipment and can be utilized to create different orientation, pitch, and
spacing of the container prior to or in the packaging machine.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][72]
[A picture of several mechanical parts.]

#### Container Handling Machines

Moving your products from application to application isn’t as simple as allowing them to flow down a
conveyor. Sometimes, they need to be in different or unique configurations in order to flow smoothly
into the packaging machine downstream.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][73]

#### Change Parts 

Change Parts are critical components to run different and new container sizes on any production
line. To perform changeovers, you need the right stars, guides, and feed screws on hand to reduce
downtime and maximize your throughput for different runs.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][74]

#### Drive Screw Units

Improve your packaging line with flexible timing screw drive units. Each standard drive unit is
equipped with timing screws [feed screws] to perform the necessary application on your line or in
conjunction with your equipment.

## Find Your Next Conveyance Solution

##### Learn about our product lines and how we can tackle your production challenges.

#### Timing Screws

Timing Screws and Feed Screws are used to move and guide products through packaging equipment
machines. They feed the equipment and can be utilized to create different orientation, pitch, and
spacing of the container prior to or in the packaging machine.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][72]
[A picture of several mechanical parts.]

#### Container Handling Machines

Moving your products from application to application isn’t as simple as allowing them to flow down a
conveyor. Sometimes, they need to be in different or unique configurations in order to flow smoothly
into the packaging machine downstream.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][73]

#### Change Parts 

Change Parts are critical components to run different and new container sizes on any production
line. To perform changeovers, you need the right stars, guides, and feed screws on hand to reduce
downtime and maximize your throughput for different runs.
[ Learn More arrow_forward ][74]

#### Drive Screw Units

Improve your packaging line with flexible timing screw drive units. Each standard drive unit is
equipped with timing screws [feed screws] to perform the necessary application on your line or in
conjunction with your equipment.

We started Nestly and Co with one simple belief — that every home deserves to be beautiful,
functional, and kind to the earth.

We know how overwhelming it can be to find home essentials that actually align with your values.
Products that look good, work well, and don't cost the planet in the process. That's exactly why we
created Nestly and Co — a curated destination for modern, eco-friendly home goods that make
intentional living effortless and accessible for everyone.

Every collection we carry — from our Kitchen & Dining Essentials to our Healing & Pampering goods,
our Living Room finds to our Rest & Restore bedroom pieces — is handpicked with purpose. We look for
natural materials, clean minimalist designs, and sustainable craftsmanship in everything we offer,
because we believe the details matter.

## FAQ

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I place an order?**
A: Shopping with Nestly and Co is easy! Simply browse our collections, add your favorite items to
your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive a confirmation email once your order is
successfully placed.

**Q: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?**
A: We process orders quickly to ensure fast delivery. If you need to make changes, please contact us
within 24 hours of placing your order and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods available at
checkout. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

**Q: Where do you ship to?**
A: We ship to customers worldwide! Shipping availability and rates will be calculated at checkout
based on your location.

**Q: How long does delivery take?**
A: Delivery times vary depending on your location. Typically orders are processed within 1-3
business days and delivered within 7-20 business days. You will receive a tracking number once your
order has been dispatched.

**Q: How do I track my order?**
A: Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a confirmation email with your tracking number.
You can use this to monitor your delivery status at any time.

**Q: Why is my order taking longer than expected?**
A: Occasionally, delivery times may be affected by high demand, weather conditions, or international
customs processing. Rest assured we are always working to get your order to you as quickly as
possible. Feel free to contact us if you have any concerns.

**Q: What is your return policy?**
A: We want you to love every Nestly and Co purchase. If you're not completely satisfied, you may
return eligible items within 30 days of delivery in their original, unused condition. Please contact
our support team to initiate a return.

**Q: How do I request a refund?**
A: Simply reach out to our customer support team with your order number and reason for the return.
Once your return is received and inspected, your refund will be processed within 5-10 business days.

**Q: What if my item arrives damaged or defective?**
A: We sincerely apologize if your item arrives in less than perfect condition. Please contact us
within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damage and we will arrange a replacement or full
refund right away.

**Q: How can I contact Nestly and Co?**
A: We'd love to hear from you! You can reach our customer support team via our Contact Us page or
email us directly. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24-48 business hours.

## FAQ

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I place an order?**
A: Shopping with Nestly and Co is easy! Simply browse our collections, add your favorite items to
your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll receive a confirmation email once your order is
successfully placed.

**Q: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?**
A: We process orders quickly to ensure fast delivery. If you need to make changes, please contact us
within 24 hours of placing your order and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods available at
checkout. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

**Q: Where do you ship to?**
A: We ship to customers worldwide! Shipping availability and rates will be calculated at checkout
based on your location.

**Q: How long does delivery take?**
A: Delivery times vary depending on your location. Typically orders are processed within 1-3
business days and delivered within 7-20 business days. You will receive a tracking number once your
order has been dispatched.

**Q: How do I track my order?**
A: Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a confirmation email with your tracking number.
You can use this to monitor your delivery status at any time.

**Q: Why is my order taking longer than expected?**
A: Occasionally, delivery times may be affected by high demand, weather conditions, or international
customs processing. Rest assured we are always working to get your order to you as quickly as
possible. Feel free to contact us if you have any concerns.

**Q: What is your return policy?**
A: We want you to love every Nestly and Co purchase. If you're not completely satisfied, you may
return eligible items within 30 days of delivery in their original, unused condition. Please contact
our support team to initiate a return.

**Q: How do I request a refund?**
A: Simply reach out to our customer support team with your order number and reason for the return.
Once your return is received and inspected, your refund will be processed within 5-10 business days.

**Q: What if my item arrives damaged or defective?**
A: We sincerely apologize if your item arrives in less than perfect condition. Please contact us
within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the damage and we will arrange a replacement or full
refund right away.

**Q: How can I contact Nestly and Co?**
A: We'd love to hear from you! You can reach our customer support team via our Contact Us page or
email us directly. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 24-48 business hours.

**Q: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?**
A: We're working on something exciting for our loyal Nestly and Co customers! Stay tuned and sign up
for our newsletter to be the first to know when it launches.

**Q: How do I stay updated on new arrivals and promotions?**
A: Sign up for our newsletter and follow us on social media to stay in the loop on new collections,
exclusive deals, and sustainability tips from Nestly and Co.

# 考えるを哲学する会社

Open the door to the future with innovative technology.
[contact][8]

## services

##### 事業内容

[

#### ICT Integration

][9]


お客様のビジネスニーズを深く理解し、ITシステムの構築から運用・保守まで、ワンストップ提供します

異なるシステムをシームレスに統合し、ビジネスプロセスの合理化や効率化、生産性の向上を実現することで、
お客様のビジネス課題に最適なソリューションを提供いたします

[see more][10]

[

#### Business Consulting

][11]


お客様のビジネスの課題や機会を深く理解し、業界・市場動向を踏まえた最適な戦略策定をご提案します

経営戦略の策定や新規事業の開発、プロセスの最適化やデジタル化、組織変革や人材育成など、ビジネスに関わ
る様々な課題に対してコンサルティングサービスを提供しています

[see more][12]

[

#### DX Support

][13]


お客様のビジネスを深く理解し、業種や規模を問わず、持続可能で最適なDX推進をサポートします

DX実現に向けてお客様のニーズに応じて、DX戦略の策定から実行支援まで、幅広い領域でDX推進をサポートする
サービスを提供しています

[see more][14]

#### E-Commerce

オンラインプラットフォームを通じて、商品やサービスを提供することにより、顧客に対して便利でスムーズな
ショッピング体験を提供いたします。

品質の高い製品や、信頼性のある取引手続き、質の高いカスタマーサポートに重点を置き、顧客満足度を最大化
することを目指しています。

[openers online（準備中）][15]

## about us

**what is openers ?**

**open** という単語には

開ける，打ち開く，広げる，切り開く，始める，開幕する，開放されている，公開されている，自由な、広々と
した…等の意味があります

その「open」という単語に「-er（する人）」と、複数形を表す「-s」を接続し「openers」という組織や集団を
表現してます

[rocket-logo]
[about us][16]

## recruits

##### 採用情報
##### 
##### 私たちは、自分自身やチームの成果に責任を持ち、自ら進んで行動する
##### オーナーシップの精神を大切にしています
##### 
##### 自ら進んで課題を解決することができる人が、自分らしく働ける環境です

[[sales]][17]
[

#### Sales Engineer


これからもっと大きくなるために、やる気とチャレンジ精神旺盛な方を募集しています！
営業経験がある方も、未経験者でも歓迎します！！
自分の力で会社の成長を支えてみませんか？

][18]
[[developer]][19]
[

#### System Developer


モダンなテクノロジーを追求し、最先端のエンジニアリングに取り組んでいます！

一緒にクリエイティブなプロジェクトに挑戦しましょう！

][20]
[[designer]][21]
[

#### Designer


アイデア豊かでオリジナルなデザインができるデザイナーを募集しています。

Webデザインから広告制作まで、クライアントの要望に応えるために一緒に働きましょう！

][22]
[[backoffice]][23]
[

#### Back Office


未経験者でも、丁寧な研修とOJTによりスキルアップを図り、一緒に業務改善に取り組んでいただける方を求め
ています。

明るく元気な職場で、一緒に働きましょう！

][24]

## Please feel free to
## contact us.

# 考えるを哲学する会社

Open the door to the future with innovative technology.
[contact][8]

## services

##### 事業内容

[

#### ICT Integration

][9]


お客様のビジネスニーズを深く理解し、ITシステムの構築から運用・保守まで、ワンストップ提供します

異なるシステムをシームレスに統合し、ビジネスプロセスの合理化や効率化、生産性の向上を実現することで、
お客様のビジネス課題に最適なソリューションを提供いたします

[see more][10]

[

#### Business Consulting

][11]


お客様のビジネスの課題や機会を深く理解し、業界・市場動向を踏まえた最適な戦略策定をご提案します

経営戦略の策定や新規事業の開発、プロセスの最適化やデジタル化、組織変革や人材育成など、ビジネスに関わ
る様々な課題に対してコンサルティングサービスを提供しています

[see more][12]

[

#### DX Support

][13]


お客様のビジネスを深く理解し、業種や規模を問わず、持続可能で最適なDX推進をサポートします

DX実現に向けてお客様のニーズに応じて、DX戦略の策定から実行支援まで、幅広い領域でDX推進をサポートする
サービスを提供しています

[see more][14]

#### E-Commerce

オンラインプラットフォームを通じて、商品やサービスを提供することにより、顧客に対して便利でスムーズな
ショッピング体験を提供いたします。

品質の高い製品や、信頼性のある取引手続き、質の高いカスタマーサポートに重点を置き、顧客満足度を最大化
することを目指しています。

[openers online（準備中）][15]

## about us

**what is openers ?**

**open** という単語には

開ける，打ち開く，広げる，切り開く，始める，開幕する，開放されている，公開されている，自由な、広々と
した…等の意味があります

その「open」という単語に「-er（する人）」と、複数形を表す「-s」を接続し「openers」という組織や集団を
表現してます

[rocket-logo]
[about us][16]

## recruits

##### 採用情報
##### 
##### 私たちは、自分自身やチームの成果に責任を持ち、自ら進んで行動する
##### オーナーシップの精神を大切にしています
##### 
##### 自ら進んで課題を解決することができる人が、自分らしく働ける環境です

[[sales]][17]
[

#### Sales Engineer


これからもっと大きくなるために、やる気とチャレンジ精神旺盛な方を募集しています！
営業経験がある方も、未経験者でも歓迎します！！
自分の力で会社の成長を支えてみませんか？

][18]
[[developer]][19]
[

#### System Developer


モダンなテクノロジーを追求し、最先端のエンジニアリングに取り組んでいます！

一緒にクリエイティブなプロジェクトに挑戦しましょう！

][20]
[[designer]][21]
[

#### Designer


アイデア豊かでオリジナルなデザインができるデザイナーを募集しています。

Webデザインから広告制作まで、クライアントの要望に応えるために一緒に働きましょう！

][22]
[[backoffice]][23]
[

#### Back Office


未経験者でも、丁寧な研修とOJTによりスキルアップを図り、一緒に業務改善に取り組んでいただける方を求め
ています。

明るく元気な職場で、一緒に働きましょう！

][24]

# Insert Multiple URLs

Please insert bulk website URLs in below text area and click on Go Now button.

## About Bulk URL Opener for Multiple Links or Websites

Opening multiple URLs seems hectic when you have to first copy and then paste each URL one by one in
different web browser tabs especially if your work is related to open multiple websites at a time
like web-hosting providers, and any digital marketing executive who checks bulk links at a time. So
how about copying all the URLs and paste it in a single text area and then just single click and all
websites are open without much hassle. There is no limit of URLs to open in multiple URL opener. You
can open 20-25 URLs at a time on a single click here.


## How to use Open Multiple URL Tool?
1. Simply just Copy (CTRL+C) and Paste (CTRL+V) the URLs in [**Open Multiple URL**][3] text area.
   Each Website URL or link must be on separate line
2. Click “GO NOW” button and your result will be processed and the web pages instantly start opening
   in the web browser
3. All listed URLs open in different browser tabs. This tool is very easy to use and free of cost.
   No downloading is needed, you can use it online from anywhere where there is Internet access


## Who should use Multiple Url Opener Website Tool?

Following users can use this tool for their work purpose

**SEO Webmasters:** If you are working as an SEO expert or a webmaster, this tool is really helpful.
As you have to access the number of websites and open all URLs at the same time. This is the
Multiple Web URL Opener tool where you can put all the URLs and open multiple URLs at a time.

**Web Data Research & Mining Experts:** If you have to search and find lot on web information and
need to bulk websites at a time then this Bulk URL Opener can help you in opening sites in single
click saving your time and efforts.

**Content Creators/ Writers:** Content writers have to research too much about their topic before
writing it down and then spin it and check for plagiarism to make it unique and relevant. For that
they have to open multiple URLs to collect the data, this tool is helpful for them.

## Where You can use it and its benefits

This tool is One-Click, No Install required tool and also known as bulk URL opener. Open Multiple
URLs tool not only helps SEO experts but content writers, web researchers, employers also. SEO
experts may need to check the page speed, simultaneous connections, site load time, and other site
related factors. For them, it is really helpful. Researchers may also use it to open multiple URLs
on a web browser.

## Bulk URL Opener Hardware/ Software Compatibility
* Open on any updated website browser like Mozilla Firefox
* Works on all editions of the Windows, Linux & IOS Operating systems
* Can be accessed on all the computers or smart devices like phones, tablets
* All major website browsers including Internet Explorer, Firefox, [Chrome][4], [Safari][5], and
  Opera support this tool
* If you try opening too many URLs/ links at one time, your web browser may freeze for a few seconds


# FAQ

#### [ How can I get the Web sites to show in tabs? ][6]

You can adjust your browser so that every URL opens in a new tab. Here’s how:

For Firefox click the Edit pull-down menu, select Preferences, then Tabs, then checkmark the “Force
links that open new windows to open in” line, and finally, select the “a new tab” option. Finally,
save your changes and exit.

#### [ How can I Use Open Multiple URL in Chrome ? ][7]

By Default chrome blocks all the popup windows. You need allow access of all the tabs from
http://www.openmultipleurl.com/

#### [ Its is not showing the URL’s, I entered ][8]

our browser may limit the number of pages that can be opened at one time, or you may have a pop-up
blocker enabled.

For older versions of Chrome click the Chrome menu in the upper right (the three bars) then click
Settings and then Show advanced settings… (at the bottom of the page). Under the “Privacy” heading,
click the Content settings button. Scroll down to the “Pop-ups” section and click Manage exceptions.
In the Add new hostname field, type “openmultipleurl.com” and select the Allow option. Click the OK
button. Unfortunately, this option does not seem to be available on newer versions of Chrome

#### [ What is your privacy policy? ][9]

Openmultipleurl.com collect only anonymous user statistics, no personally identifiable information.

Copyright © 2012-2023 [**Open Multiple URLs**][10]

# Insert Multiple URLs

Please insert bulk website URLs in below text area and click on Go Now button.

## About Bulk URL Opener for Multiple Links or Websites

Opening multiple URLs seems hectic when you have to first copy and then paste each URL one by one in
different web browser tabs especially if your work is related to open multiple websites at a time
like web-hosting providers, and any digital marketing executive who checks bulk links at a time. So
how about copying all the URLs and paste it in a single text area and then just single click and all
websites are open without much hassle. There is no limit of URLs to open in multiple URL opener. You
can open 20-25 URLs at a time on a single click here.


## How to use Open Multiple URL Tool?
1. Simply just Copy (CTRL+C) and Paste (CTRL+V) the URLs in [**Open Multiple URL**][3] text area.
   Each Website URL or link must be on separate line
2. Click “GO NOW” button and your result will be processed and the web pages instantly start opening
   in the web browser
3. All listed URLs open in different browser tabs. This tool is very easy to use and free of cost.
   No downloading is needed, you can use it online from anywhere where there is Internet access


## Who should use Multiple Url Opener Website Tool?

Following users can use this tool for their work purpose

**SEO Webmasters:** If you are working as an SEO expert or a webmaster, this tool is really helpful.
As you have to access the number of websites and open all URLs at the same time. This is the
Multiple Web URL Opener tool where you can put all the URLs and open multiple URLs at a time.

**Web Data Research & Mining Experts:** If you have to search and find lot on web information and
need to bulk websites at a time then this Bulk URL Opener can help you in opening sites in single
click saving your time and efforts.

**Content Creators/ Writers:** Content writers have to research too much about their topic before
writing it down and then spin it and check for plagiarism to make it unique and relevant. For that
they have to open multiple URLs to collect the data, this tool is helpful for them.

## Where You can use it and its benefits

This tool is One-Click, No Install required tool and also known as bulk URL opener. Open Multiple
URLs tool not only helps SEO experts but content writers, web researchers, employers also. SEO
experts may need to check the page speed, simultaneous connections, site load time, and other site
related factors. For them, it is really helpful. Researchers may also use it to open multiple URLs
on a web browser.

## Bulk URL Opener Hardware/ Software Compatibility
* Open on any updated website browser like Mozilla Firefox
* Works on all editions of the Windows, Linux & IOS Operating systems
* Can be accessed on all the computers or smart devices like phones, tablets
* All major website browsers including Internet Explorer, Firefox, [Chrome][4], [Safari][5], and
  Opera support this tool
* If you try opening too many URLs/ links at one time, your web browser may freeze for a few seconds


# FAQ

#### [ How can I get the Web sites to show in tabs? ][6]

You can adjust your browser so that every URL opens in a new tab. Here’s how:

For Firefox click the Edit pull-down menu, select Preferences, then Tabs, then checkmark the “Force
links that open new windows to open in” line, and finally, select the “a new tab” option. Finally,
save your changes and exit.

#### [ How can I Use Open Multiple URL in Chrome ? ][7]

By Default chrome blocks all the popup windows. You need allow access of all the tabs from
http://www.openmultipleurl.com/

#### [ Its is not showing the URL’s, I entered ][8]

our browser may limit the number of pages that can be opened at one time, or you may have a pop-up
blocker enabled.

For older versions of Chrome click the Chrome menu in the upper right (the three bars) then click
Settings and then Show advanced settings… (at the bottom of the page). Under the “Privacy” heading,
click the Content settings button. Scroll down to the “Pop-ups” section and click Manage exceptions.
In the Add new hostname field, type “openmultipleurl.com” and select the Allow option. Click the OK
button. Unfortunately, this option does not seem to be available on newer versions of Chrome

#### [ What is your privacy policy? ][9]

Openmultipleurl.com collect only anonymous user statistics, no personally identifiable information.

Everyone owns an email address each and every hour, for everything from connecting at work, with
business prospects, reaching out to friends and colleagues using the email address as an online
passport. Nearly 99% of all apps and services we sign-up today required an email address, likewise
to most shoppers loyalty cards, contest and offer entries, and more.

We all enjoy having an email address, but getting tons of spam emails each day doesn’t feel
comfortable. Furthermore, it’s entirely common for stores to have their databases hacked, leaving
your business email address at risk and more likely to end up on spam lists. Still, nothing done

disposable emails address.

Recently, I found a bounce rate complex than usual on my latest email blast! I later realized the

addresses.

Disposable email address (DEA) technically means an approach where a user’s with a unique email
address gets a temporary email address for your current contact. The DEA allow the creation of an
email address that passes validity need to sign-up for services and website without having to show
your true identity.

Disposable emails address if compromised or used in connection with email abuse online, the owner
can’t be tied to the abuse and quickly cancel its application without affecting other contacts. With
temporary mail, you can you receive your emails from the fake emails in your genuine emails address
for a specified time set. The fake email address is simply a through-away email, temporary email set
and self-destructs email.

original (genuine) after the trial period expires.

An offline or online retailer tend to demand an email address to take advantage of their offers,

# Effortless Can Opening at the Touch of a Button

Discover the Canslab difference. Our modern, rechargeable electric can openers bring safety, speed,
and hands-free convenience to your kitchen. Designed for everyone, especially those with arthritis,
for a smooth, perfect cut every time.

[Check details][11]

##### One-Touch Operation

Automatically cuts and shuts off, freeing your hands for other cooking tasks.

##### USB Rechargeable

Built-in 2000mAh battery effortlessly opens up to 120 cans on a single quick charge.

##### Smooth Edge Tech

Cuts along the side of the lid, leaving a safe, smooth edge without touching food.

### Welcome to The Kitchen Craft Hub 

# Elevate Your Culinary Experience


The Kitchen Craft Hub serves as your ultimate source for culinary excellence, offering a
comprehensive selection of premium kitchen essentials designed to inspire both novice cooks and
seasoned chefs. Our mission is to bridge the gap between professional performance and home
convenience by providing high-quality tools that empower your creativity in the heart of the home.
We understand that a well-equipped kitchen is the foundation of a healthy lifestyle, which is why
our value proposition centers on speed, user-friendly shopping, and affordable prices without
compromising on structural integrity. Our primary offerings include heavy-duty cookware, precision
cutlery, and advanced small appliances like food processors and pressure cookers. By sourcing goods
from trusted manufacturers, we ensure that every customer can invest in reliable gear that
simplifies meal preparation and enhances the flavors of every dish.

## Explore Diverse Categories for a More Organized and Efficient Kitchen


At The Kitchen Craft Hub, our category breadth extends far beyond basic tools to include specialized
solutions for every aspect of dining and food preservation. From professional-grade bakeware and
serving ware to stylish linens and textiles, we offer products that cater to various customer use
cases, such as hosting elegant dinner parties or managing a busy weeknight meal schedule. Our
storage and organization solutions are particularly beneficial for those looking to maximize space

## From $1 Banner Ads to 30 Years Online

I made my first dollar on the internet in 1997 selling banner ads to strangers in AOL chat rooms.
People mailed me actual dollar bills. It was ridiculous and I was hooked immediately.

Since then I’ve built email lists with millions of subscribers, launched sites that hit 100,000+
daily visitors, spoken at conferences around the world, and yes, lost it all a couple of times too.
That’s kind of the point.

This blog is where I put everything I’ve learned, everything I remember, and everything I’m still
figuring out.
